subject: Unable to run analysis in one laptop

messages.author: 11d96e727e663ab7
messages.subject: Unable to run analysis in one laptop
parts:
Dear all
I am beginner in using Distance Sampling.
I am unable to get outputs when I click "Run selected analysis" in Project Browser in my own laptop. I tried in several ways (deactivating antivirus, uninstalling, cleaning, reinstalling).
While uninstalling I had got a popup saying "Could not open INSTALL.LOG file". I used IObit Uninstaller to uninstall as it did not install in normal way.
Same process works very well in next laptop.

I still can't get output when I run any of the models in my own laptop (My laptop is DEL, window 10 i5). Please help me if I have missed anything in setting.

Thank you so much
Sabita Gurung

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Unable to run analysis in one laptop
parts:
Sabita

Welcome to the group; sorry to hear you are having problems with Distance.  You have two questions:  1) unable to get output, 2) uninstall problems.  There is possibly a third question, "it did not install in normal way".

I suspect that using a different piece of software to uninstall Distance than the "unwise.exe" uninstaller might explain the "could not open install.log".  I'd need more information to unravel your meaning of "not install in normal way".

I would also like you to provide more detail about what output you were unable to get.  Your screen capture shows the results browser table without entries, but that is not necessarily indicative of no output.  It would be more enlightening to look at the Log window and the Results window to see what actually was accomplished when you ran your analysis.

If your output window is empty, the problem may arise from the language setting of your computer's operating system.  If you have told your operating system that you are in Chinese/Japanese/Korean, this may cause the output window to be empty.  If this is the case, the solution is to do this:

Under 'Tools' on the menu, select Preferences.  On the tab marked 'General' untick the box labelled 'Store results in compressed format in project databases'  This will prevent the use of compression software that alters Chinese/Japanese/Korean languages.

Finally, I would be curious to know the differences between the laptop that could run your analysis and the laptop that could not.  There may be some clues to the problem if we knew those differences.

We may need further emails to pinpoint the problem, which I suggest we do off-list.  When we find a solution, you can report this back to the entire list.

messages.author: 11d96e727e663ab7
messages.subject: Re: Unable to run analysis in one laptop
parts:
Dear all
I am writing as follow-up to me above issue. I would like to share that I can now run the analysis which was showing issues earlier. Below are points I needed to consider to get the solution.
  • To turn off antivirus totally before the installation of the software.
  • To install Distance software in different location than the default location.
  • To name the software as "Distance7" rather than default name with space before 7 as in "Distance 7".
When I reinstalled the software second and third time after turning off the software and uninstalling the software, and reinstalling it, it didn't work at all. In that case, installing in new location (naming it as "Distance7") worked with antivirus turned off since before uninstalling.

Thank you so much Eric for your guidance in solving this issue and prompt responses.

Sincerely
Sabita Gurung
